settings.heading: Meet Diksha
settings.body:
Diksha Agrawal founded Dimohe after moving from India to the United States.

She grew up around Indian craft and wanted to make it easier to find pieces that worked in a modern home and wardrobe. That became the idea behind Dimohe.

With a background in sales and strategy, Diksha brings that interest in craft to the way she builds the collection. Home textiles, hand-embroidered bags, wellness, and children’s clothing sit together here because they are all part of how we live.
